title: Core of Scottsville

services.name: Boot Camp
services.desc: Welcome to Boot Camp at The Core of Scottsville, where we push your limits and transform your fitness through high-intensity, full-body workouts. Our Boot Camp program is designed to challenge you, build strength, and increase endurance, all while fostering a spirit of camaraderie and motivation. Boot Camp at The Core of Scottsville is a comprehensive fitness experience that combines various training methods to deliver maximum results. Our sessions incorporate elements of cardio, strength training, functional movements, and high-intensity interval training (HIIT) to create a balanced and effective workout regimen. Are you ready to take on the Boot Camp challenge and transform your fitness?

services.name: Fun Company/Summer Day Camp
services.desc: Fun Company is a before and after school daycare program designed with learning and fun in mind. We want to create a safe and fun environment before and after school, with snacks, homework help, and fun activities every day. We have planned swimming days on Fridays to give our Fun Company kids a great opportunity to kick the weekend off right! Fun Company has themed days through the week to encourage a love of learning while also having a fun time. Allen County Schools pick up and let out here at The Core, and childcare staff are ready to get the kids on and off the bus. The Core of Scottsville is a 501(c)(3) non-profit organization and proudly serves the South Central Kentucky area.
